> Using `gh` or a coding agent? GitHub CLI v2.99+ uploads media with `gh pr create --attach ./demo.mp4` or `gh pr edit <number> --attach ./demo.mp4`. Repeat `--attach` for multiple files. Use the CLI when available with repository write access; otherwise, upload through GitHub's web UI. [Attachment guide](https://github.blog/changelog/2026-09-01-github-cli-media-in-issues-pull-requests-and-comments/).
